entry.title: Tree Removal to Cause I-5 Delays Near Sutherlin and Oakland
entry.summary: Drivers should expect delays on I-5 near Sutherlin and Oakland from Sept. 28 through Oct. 2 as crews remove about 80 dead and dying trees. Rolling slowdowns will affect both directions between mileposts 135 and 140, with most delays lasting less than 20 minutes.
